scope.purpose: Represent a person, or an organization, a team or a project, with a picture, their initials or a generic glyph, in a small box of fixed size beside or instead of their name.
useCases: The author of a comment, the assignee of a task, the owner of a record (beside the name, decorative).
A person alone where the name does not fit (a table cell, a compact list), named for assistive technology.
An organization, a team or a project with the square shape.
The current user in an application header, wrapped by the integration in the button that opens the account menu.
exclusions: A presence or status dot over the avatar (online, busy): a later composition with Badge.
Colors derived from the name: needs a categorical palette the foundations do not have.
Upload or cropping of a picture.
Interactivity of its own: the integration wraps the avatar in a button or a link.
alternatives: Icon for a symbol that does not represent an identity.
Badge or Counter for a status or a quantity.
Plain text when the name alone is enough.

fixtures: Portrait pictures for the examples (local files under examples/avatar/, no network).

decisionsTaken: Sizes xs to xl as the component tokens recorded in the catalog: component.avatar.size.{xs,sm,md,lg,xl} = 24, 32, 40, 48, 64 px.

Initials in a component typography component.avatar.typography.{size} (Inter medium 500, line height 1): 11, 13, 16, 18, 24 px (about 0.4 of the box). No semantic typography maps the five sizes; a component token is the naming rule's answer for a value only the Avatar needs. Generated as a Figma text style by the existing manifest (generic).
xs shows one initial: two medium initials at 11 px leave no margin in a 24 px circle (WM is about 20 px wide).
Initials: first grapheme of the first and of the last word, uppercased with the platform's locale rules; a single word gives one character.
Fallback in color.surface.muted with color.content.secondary (a measured pair of the semantic inventory); no colors from the name in v1.
Square corners proportional to the size (component.avatar.radius.{size} = 4, 6, 8, 8, 12 px) rather than one radius for all sizes.
Generic glyph: Phosphor user (regular), copied into the component folder as an intrinsic glyph, box component.avatar.icon-size.{size} = 16, 20, 24, 28, 40 px.
No edge around pictures in v1 (a translucent edge would need a role the foundations do not have); an edge only in forced colors.
The fallback stays visible while the picture loads; the picture replaces it once loaded (no fade in v1). Bits UI Avatar provides the loading status.

Neutral avatars only (user at the wave 5 contract gate, round 1 (2026-11-13): "Reste sur des avatars neutre, c'est à chaque application de faire ensuite la logique désirée"): colors, generated portraits or illustrations belong to the application (it can pass a picture or set the colors).

An avatar that opens a menu is wrapped by the integration in a button or another interactive area; no slot in Button or IconButton (user at the wave 5 contract gate, round 1 (2026-11-13): "Plutôt bouton ... A toi de suivre ta recommandation"); shown as a documentation example.
Round 2: new prop initials (at most three characters, shown as given) replacing the computed initials, for an organization's abbreviation and for the +N box of AvatarGroup.
Implementation: Svelte API: role img named by name on the root span; decorative or nameless avatars get aria-hidden; consumer attributes go to the root after Bits UI's.
nextAction: Wave 5 documentation gate (grouped review on the preview site).
implementationNotes: Exports Avatar and the types AvatarProps, AvatarImageStatus.

Bits UI Avatar reports the loading status; ggbrick keeps it per source (a new src starts again from loading, since Bits UI does not reload once a picture has loaded) and renders the picture only without Bits UI's fallback part: the initials or the glyph are drawn while imageStatus is not loaded.
Initials: Intl.Segmenter graphemes (fallback to code points), leading punctuation skipped, words without letters or digits ignored, toLocaleUpperCase; initials.ts in the component folder.
The generic glyph is Phosphor user (regular) inline, attributed in the markup.
Initials are centered on their capital height with text-box trim (browsers without it center the line box).
